---
title: "Benchmark: lba"
output: github_document
---

Fits every drift distribution and the custom version once on simulated data and
reports time, convergence and divergences. Too slow for testthat; knit by hand.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
devtools::load_all(".")
seed <- 365 # the seed of internal-model-tests.Rmd, where this section first ran
```

```{r lba_benchmark_helpers}
count_divergences <- function(fit) {
  np <- brms::nuts_params(fit)
  sum(np$Parameter == "divergent__" & np$Value == 1)
}

run_lba_benchmark <- function(data, model, formula) {
  elapsed <- system.time(
    fit <- bmm(formula, data, model,
               cores = 2,
               chains = 2,
               iter = 500,
               refresh = 0,
               silent = 2,
               backend = "cmdstanr",
               seed = seed)
  )[["elapsed"]]

  fixed <- summary(fit)$fixed
  list(
    fit = fit,
    metrics = data.frame(
      elapsed_sec = elapsed,
      max_rhat = max(fixed[, "Rhat"], na.rm = TRUE),
      min_bulk_ess = min(fixed[, "Bulk_ESS"], na.rm = TRUE),
      min_tail_ess = min(fixed[, "Tail_ESS"], na.rm = TRUE),
      divergences = count_divergences(fit)
    )
  )
}
```

```{r lba_benchmark_fits}
set.seed(seed)

lba_normal_data <- rlba(
  n = 500,
  drift = c(3, 1.5),
  gap = 0.5,
  sp = 0.5,
  ndt = 0.2
)
lba_gamma_data <- rlba(
  n = 500,
  drift = c(2.5, 1.3),
  gap = 0.5,
  sp = 0.5,
  ndt = 0.2,
  distribution = "gamma"
)
lba_lognormal_data <- rlba(
  n = 500,
  drift = c(0.5, 0.1),
  gap = 0.5,
  sp = 0.5,
  ndt = 0.2,
  distribution = "lognormal"
)
lba_frechet_data <- rlba(
  n = 500,
  drift = c(2.5, 1.5),
  gap = 0.5,
  sp = 0.5,
  ndt = 0.2,
  distribution = "frechet"
)
lba_custom_data <- lba_normal_data
lba_custom_data$response <- ifelse(lba_custom_data$response == 1, "correct", "wrong")

lba_bench <- list(
  normal = run_lba_benchmark(
    lba_normal_data,
    lba(rt = "rt", response = "response", n_choices = 2),
    bmf(driftc ~ 1, drifte ~ 1, gap ~ 1, sp ~ 1, ndt ~ 1)
  ),
  gamma = run_lba_benchmark(
    lba_gamma_data,
    lba(rt = "rt", response = "response", n_choices = 2,
        distribution = "gamma"),
    bmf(driftc ~ 1, drifte ~ 1, gap ~ 1, sp ~ 1, ndt ~ 1)
  ),
  lognormal = run_lba_benchmark(
    lba_lognormal_data,
    lba(rt = "rt", response = "response", n_choices = 2,
        distribution = "lognormal"),
    bmf(driftc ~ 1, drifte ~ 1, gap ~ 1, sp ~ 1, ndt ~ 1)
  ),
  frechet = run_lba_benchmark(
    lba_frechet_data,
    lba(rt = "rt", response = "response", n_choices = 2,
        distribution = "frechet"),
    bmf(driftc ~ 1, drifte ~ 1, gap ~ 1, sp ~ 1, ndt ~ 1)
  ),
  custom = run_lba_benchmark(
    lba_custom_data,
    lba(rt = "rt", response = "response", version = "custom"),
    bmf(correct ~ 1, wrong ~ 1, gap ~ 1, sp ~ 1, ndt ~ 1)
  )
)
```

```{r lba_benchmark_metrics}
dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(lba_bench), function(name) {
  cbind(model = name, lba_bench[[name]]$metrics)
}))
```

```{r lba_benchmark_summaries}
lapply(lba_bench, function(x) summary(x$fit)$fixed)
```
